description: This file defines the RateLimitedOutputStream class, a custom OutputStream that enforces a rate limit on data writing, used within Spark Streaming for controlled output flow.

classes.name: RateLimitedOutputStream
classes.description: A custom OutputStream that limits the data write rate to a specified number of bytes per second.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a single byte to the output stream after rate limiting.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes an array of bytes to the output stream after rate limiting.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Recursively writes a portion of a byte array to the output stream with rate limiting.

methods.name: waitToWrite
methods.description: Ensures that writing the specified number of bytes does not exceed the desired rate by sleeping if necessary.
